versions.changelog:
- Renamed the skill from "camscanner-pdf2office" to "camscanner-image2office".
- Updated functionality to support converting images (not PDFs) to editable Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx) documents.
- Changed the main conversion API step to use the convert_image endpoint for image input.
- Updated trigger phrases and description to focus on image-to-Office document use cases, including OCR for text and tables.
- Adjusted usage examples, API references, and troubleshooting sections for image workflows.

Major update: The skill now converts PDF files to editable Office formats instead of images.

- Renamed skill to focus on PDF-to-Office conversion (camscanner-pdf2office).
- Updated triggers and description to handle PDF-to-Word (.docx) and PDF-to-Excel (.xlsx) conversions.
- Changed API usage to use /convert_pdf endpoint (was /convert_image).
- Adjusted documentation to reference PDFs instead of images throughout.
- Updated file extension mapping, supported conversions, and error handling examples for PDF input.

- Initial release of CamScanner Image to Office skill.
- Convert images containing text or tables into editable Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx) files while preserving complex layouts.
- Handles quick, 3-step pipeline: upload image, convert, and download Office document.
- Designed for high-fidelity recognition of tables, text, and formatting.
- Privacy: Files are processed in real-time by CamScanner servers and not permanently stored.
